name: dsh-codebase-memory
description: DSH host bundle: index the session workspace with codebase-memory-mcp, expose it through @njuptlzf/mcp-adapter (one ~250-token MCP proxy tool instead of 17 tool schemas), and add trigger layers — code_find/code_callers wrappers, optional grep/glob intercept, conditional runtime context, write-after staleness tracking — so symbol lookups reach the code graph without depending on how the question was phrased. Optional built-in zvec-grep semantic layer (off by default; 430MB requires an explicit install:zg).
author: njuptlzf

scripts.check: npm run check:patch && npm run check:client && npm run check:plugin && npm run check:chain && npm run check:tokens
